chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Hammad ibn Isa, from Ibrahim ibn Umar al-Yamani, from Aban ibn Abi Ayyash, from Sulaym ibn Qays; and Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Ibn Abi Umayr, from Umar ibn Udhaynah; and Ali ibn Muhammad, from Ahmad ibn Hilal, from Ibn Abi Umayr, from Umar ibn Udhaynah, from Aban ibn Abi Ayyash, from Sulaym ibn Qays, who said:
I heard Abdullah ibn Ja‘far al-Tayyar saying: We were with Mu‘awiyah—I, al-Hasan, al-Husayn, Abdullah ibn Abbas, Umar ibn Umm Salamah, and Usamah ibn Zayd—and words passed between me and Mu‘awiyah.

So I said to Mu‘awiyah: I heard the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله say: I have greater authority over the believers than their own selves; then my brother Ali ibn Abi Talib عليه السلام has greater authority over the believers than their own selves. Then when Ali عليه السلام is martyred, al-Hasan ibn Ali عليهما السلام has greater authority over the believers than their own selves. Then after him, my son al-Husayn عليه السلام has greater authority over the believers than their own selves. Then when he is martyred, his son Ali ibn al-Husayn عليهما السلام has greater authority over the believers than their own selves, and you will meet him, O Ali. Then his son Muhammad ibn Ali عليهما السلام has greater authority over the believers than their own selves, and you will meet him, O Husayn. Then it is completed as twelve Imams, nine from the descendants of al-Husayn عليه السلام.

Abdullah ibn Ja‘far said: And I called al-Hasan, al-Husayn, Abdullah ibn Abbas, Umar ibn Umm Salamah, and Usamah ibn Zayd as witnesses, and they testified for me before Mu‘awiyah. Sulaym said: I had also heard that from Salman, Abu Dharr, and al-Miqdad, and they mentioned that they had heard it from the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله.

key_terms.أَوْلَى: having greater authority and closer right over the believers
key_terms.الْمُؤْمِنِينَ: the believers, the community of faith

ai.seo_question: What does this hadith say about the twelve Imams and the succession of authority after the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله?
ai.summary: This hadith narrates a declaration attributed to the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله establishing his prior authority over the believers and then the successive authority of Imam Ali عليه السلام, Imam al-Hasan عليه السلام, Imam al-Husayn عليه السلام, and the continuation of the line until the twelve Imams. It presents this as a witnessed report in the presence of Mu‘awiyah and reinforces it through multiple named companions.

en.hubeali: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Hammad Bin Isa, from Ibrahim Bin Umar Al Yamani, from Aban Bin Abu Ayyash, from Suleymn Bin Qays and Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Umar Bin Azina and Ali Bin Muhammad, from Ahmad Bin Hilal, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Umar Bin Azina, from Aban Bin Abu Ayyash, from Suleym Bin Qays who said,

‘I heard Abdullah Bin Ja’far Al-Tayyar saying, ‘We were in the presence of Muawiya, I, and Al-Hassan<sup>asws</sup> and Al-Husayn<sup>asws</sup>, and Abdullah Bin Abbas, and Umar son of Umm Salma<sup>as</sup>, and Asama Bin Zayd, and there flowed (heated) speech between me and Muawiya.

I said to Muawiya, ‘I heard Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> saying: ‘I<sup>saww</sup> am closer with the Momineen than their own selves, then my<sup>saww</sup> brother<sup>asws</sup> Ali<sup>asws</sup> Bin Abu Talib<sup>asws</sup> is closer with the Momineen than their own selves. So when Ali<sup>asws</sup> is martyred, then Al-Hassan<sup>asws</sup> Bin Ali<sup>asws</sup> would be closer with the Momineen than their own selves, then my<sup>saww</sup> son<sup>asws</sup> Al Husayn<sup>asws</sup> Bin Ali<sup>asws</sup> from after him<sup>asws</sup> would be closer to the Momineen than their own selves. So when he<sup>asws</sup> is martyred, so it would be his<sup>asws</sup> son<sup>asws</sup> Ali<sup>asws</sup> Bin Al-Husayn<sup>asws</sup> who would be closer with the Momineen than their own selves, and you<sup>asws</sup> will be seeing him<sup>asws</sup>, O Ali<sup>asws</sup>! Then it would be his<sup>asws</sup> son<sup>asws</sup> Muhammad<sup>asws</sup> Bin Ali<sup>asws</sup> who would be closer with the Momineen than their own selves, and you<sup>asws</sup> will be seeing him<sup>asws</sup>, O Husayn<sup>asws</sup>! Then ten Imams<sup>asws</sup> would be completed, nine being from the sons<sup>asws</sup> of Al-Husayn<sup>asws</sup>’’.

Abdullah Bin Ja’far said, ‘And I made witnesses of Al-Hassan<sup>asws</sup>, and Al-Husayn<sup>asws</sup>, and Abdullah Bin Abbas, and Umar son of Umm Salma<sup>as</sup>, and Asama Bin Zayd, so they bore witness for me in the presence of Muawiya’. 
Suleym said, ‘And I had heard that from Salman<sup>as</sup>, and Abu Zarr<sup>as</sup>, and Al-Miqdad<sup>as</sup>, and they<sup>as</sup> mentioned that they<sup>as</sup> had heard that from Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup>’.
en.sarwar: 4. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father from Hammad ibn ‘Isa from Ibrahim ibn ‘Umar al-Yamani from Aban ibn abu ‘Ayyash from Sulaym ibn Qays and Muhammad ibn Yahya from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from ibn abu ‘Umayr from ‘Umar ibn ’Udhayna and Ali ibn Muhammad from Ahmad ibn Hilal from ibn abu ‘Umayr from ‘Umar ibn ’Udhayna from Aban ibn abu ‘Ayyash from Sulaym ibn Qays who has said the following.

“ I heard ‘Abdallah ibn Ja‘far al-Tayyar say, ‘we were in the court of Mu‘awiya I al-Hassan, al-Husayn, ‘Abdallah ibn ‘Abbass, ‘Umar ibn ’Umm Salama and ’Usama ibn Zayd. A conversation started between me and Mu‘awiya,

and I said to Mu‘awiya’, ’I heard the Messenger of Allah say, ‘I have more authority over the believers’ souls than they themselves do. Then my brother Ali ibn abu Talib (a.s.) will have more authority over the believers’ souls than they themselves will have. When Ali (a.s.), will become a martyr al-Hassan ibn Ali will have more authority over the believers’ souls than they themselves will have. Thereafter my son al-Husayn after him (al-Hassan) will have more authority over the believers’ souls than they themselves will have. When he will become a martyr, his son Ali ibn al-Husayn after him (al-Husayn) will have more authority over the believers’ souls than they themselves will have. O Ali, you will see him. Thereafter his son Muhammad ibn Ali will have more authority over the believers’ souls than they themselves will have. O al-Husayn, you will see him. Then the twelve will complete the number of Imams. Nine will be of the descendants of al-Husayn.”

‘Abdallah ibn Ja‘far said, “I asked al-Hassan, al-Husayn, ‘Abdallah, ibn ‘Abbass, Umar ibn ’Umm Salama and ’Usama ibn Zayd to bear witness. They all bore witness for me before Mu‘awiya.” Sulaym ibn Qays has said, “I heard such Hadith from Salman, abu Dharr and al- Miqdad who said that they heard such Hadith from the Messenger of Allah.”
